highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.147.0 previews Skia m147 with variable fonts and animated WebP encoding.
highlights_body: It adds color font palettes, sampling-aware surface draws, memory-backed stream access, Linux Bionic assets, and 64-bit Tizen support. This preview line also raises the WebAssembly floor to .NET 8 and contains breaking API and runtime changes that require migration.

breaking.title: GrVkYcbcrConversionInfo APIs move to GRVkYcbcrConversionInfo
breaking.body: `GRVkImageInfo.YcbcrConversionInfo` now uses `GRVkYcbcrConversionInfo`. Update references to the new `GR` casing; the obsolete `GrVkYcbcrConversionInfo` shim remains for migration, but no longer implements `IEquatable` or its former equality operators.

breaking.title: SKFont without a typeface now uses the empty typeface
breaking.body: `SKFont()` and `SKFont(null)` now produce an empty typeface rather than resolving the platform default. Pass `SKTypeface.Default` when text measurement or rendering requires the default system typeface.

breaking.title: SKStream.Move rejects offsets outside the native range
breaking.body: `SKStream.Move(long)` is obsolete and now uses a checked conversion to the native 32-bit offset, so out-of-range values throw `OverflowException` instead of being silently truncated. Use an in-range offset and migrate away from the long overload.

breaking.title: Tizen 32-bit native assets are removed
breaking.body: The Tizen arm and x86 native assets are no longer built or packaged. Move Tizen deployments to the supported `tizen-arm64` or `tizen-x64` runtime identifiers.

breaking.title: WebAssembly native assets now require .NET 8
breaking.body: Native WebAssembly assets for the older Emscripten versions associated with .NET 6 and .NET 7 are removed, and those targets now produce a build error. Upgrade Blazor or Uno WebAssembly projects to .NET 8 or later.

breaking.title: Assembly version moves to 4.147.0.0
breaking.body: SkiaSharp.dll now reports assembly version 4.147.0.0 instead of 3.119.0.0. Update strong-name binding redirects and any checks that depend on the previous assembly version.

bullets.lead: Bundled Skia advances to milestone m147
bullets.detail: The engine moves from m119 through m132 and m133 to m147, bringing codec orientation improvements, HDR and wide-gamut work, newer color-aware filters, CICP color spaces, and accumulated raster and filter fixes.

bullets.lead: Bundled image, font and compression libraries refreshed
bullets.detail: libpng moves to 1.6.58, libexpat to 2.7.5, zlib to 1.3.2.1-motley, FreeType to 2.14.3, and libjpeg-turbo to 3.1.4.1.

bullets.lead: Variable fonts and color font palettes
bullets.detail: `SKTypeface`, `SKFontArguments`, and HarfBuzzSharp expose variation axes, design coordinates, named instances, palette selection, and per-color overrides.
New `SKSurface.Draw` and `SKCanvas.DrawSurface` overloads accept `SKSamplingOptions`, restoring control over filtering when compositing surfaces.
`SKWebpEncoder` and `SKWebpEncoderFrame` can encode a timed sequence of pixmaps as a single animated WebP.
`SKStream.GetData()` returns a ref-counted `SKData` when the native stream can provide its contents cheaply, avoiding a copy for memory streams.

bullets.lead: Document, GPU and mask-filter wrappers completed
bullets.detail: Adds `SKDocument.CreateXps` options, per-resource `GRContext.Flush` overloads, `SKMaskFilter.CreateShader`, and the correctly cased `GRVkYcbcrConversionInfo` API.

bullets.lead: HarfBuzz colors map correctly to SkiaSharp
bullets.detail: The new `HBColor` value type represents HarfBuzz BGRA values correctly, with conversions to and from `SKColor` and `SKColorF`.

bullets.lead: Default typeface startup is more robust
bullets.detail: Default typeface resolution moves to the managed font manager, preventing Android API 36 startup crashes and allowing NanoServer to use an empty font manager where system font APIs are unavailable.

bullets.lead: Variable-font Span APIs and glyph checks corrected
bullets.detail: Undersized variation buffers now follow native all-or-nothing semantics correctly, and `SKTypeface.ContainsGlyphs` no longer recurses until a `StackOverflowException`.

bullets.lead: Android SKGLView survives tab and page navigation
bullets.detail: A reattached `SKGLView` now initializes its GL thread with the current dimensions, so returning to a MAUI tab or page no longer leaves the view blank.

bullets.lead: Negative SKStream offsets retain their sign
bullets.detail: The native stream move callback now uses an explicit 32-bit integer, preventing negative offsets from being zero-extended on LP64 platforms.

bullets.lead: SKPath finalization no longer races SKPathBuilder
bullets.detail: Disposal skips pending builder flushes once finalization begins, preventing a crash when the builder is collected before its owning path.
Dedicated `linux-bionic` packages now provide x64 and arm64 binaries for Linux environments that use Android's Bionic libc.
Native packages add `tizen-x64` and `tizen-arm64` assets, while the m147 transition removes the obsolete 32-bit arm and x86 builds.

bullets.lead: Apple target frameworks align with base workloads
bullets.detail: .NET 10 libraries target Apple platform version 26.0 rather than 26.2, avoiding an unnecessary Xcode 26.2 requirement for consumers.
SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp native WebAssembly assets retain .NET 8 and later Emscripten variants and report a clear build error for .NET 6 or .NET 7.

contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Skia m132 and m147 updates, variable fonts, managed default-typeface handling, the SKPath finalizer fix, and Uno sample maintenance

v4.147.0-preview.1.1.summary: Moves bundled Skia from m119 through m147, adding HDR/CICP color support, variable and color-font APIs, sampling-aware surface draws, managed default-typeface resolution, and corrected `SKStream` offsets. Adds Linux Bionic and 64-bit Tizen assets while dropping 32-bit Tizen, refreshes libpng and libexpat, and fixes Android `SKGLView` reattachment and font Span failures.

v4.147.0-preview.2.1.summary: Adds animated WebP encoding and `SKStream.GetData()`, fixes the `SKPath` finalizer crash, and aligns .NET 10 Apple libraries with the 26.0 platform workloads.

v4.147.0-preview.3.1.summary: Raises WebAssembly native assets to .NET 8 and moves `GrVkYcbcrConversionInfo`-facing APIs to `GRVkYcbcrConversionInfo`, while adding `HBColor`, XPS creation, per-resource GPU flushes, and shader mask filters. Refreshes libjpeg-turbo, FreeType, and zlib, and fixes default font-manager startup on NanoServer.

harfbuzz_summary: HarfBuzzSharp 8.3.1.6 adds variable-font and color-palette APIs, introduces `HBColor` for correct color conversion, and provides Linux Bionic and 64-bit Tizen native assets.
